questions.text: 3d Write a Matlab function to evaluate a polynomial of degree $n$ given in nested form, given the interpolation points $x_i$ and coefficients $a_i$.
questions.modelAnswer:
```matlab
function z = eval(a,x,w)
n = length(a);
z = a(end);
for k = n-1:-1:1
    z = a(k) + (w-x(k))*z;
end
end
```

Gershgorin circle theorem.

Applied to $B$:
$$
3.18 \leq \lambda_1 \leq 12.38
$$
$$
2.76 \leq \lambda_2 \leq 3.68
$$

Applied to $B^T$:
$$
7.32 \leq \lambda_1 \leq 8.24
$$
$$
-1.38 \leq \lambda_2 \leq 7.82
$$
